claude.approved_note: Reviewed 2026-09-09 for the 4.0.0 release. One credential identity and one egress destination, api.anthropic.com, which is what a real run contacts once the CLI's non-essential traffic is switched off; with that switch left on a second, non-Anthropic destination appears on every run. Executable trust is user-runtime because the CLI is a user-space install located from a candidate list, never through PATH. Accepted knowing the credential value reaches the sandbox environment: no credential broker exists yet, so an agent that runs a shell inside the sandbox can read it.

codex.approved_note: Reviewed as part of the Shadowfetch release.

localmodel.approved_note: Reviewed 2026-09-09 for the 4.0.0 release. No credentials and no egress: network_policy 'none' is enforced by the sandbox's own network namespace, and the model is reached over one unix socket inside the single read-granted directory, which is the only reason that grant exists. The program is the packaged bridge at an absolute path, so executable trust is system.
